storyInfo: The newly established A6 is having difficulties with teamwork. Determined to turn A6 into a true team, Orchid resolved to make efforts...

attributes.content: Popukar... Spot can't cover you if you're too far forward.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: And you were completely out of position, Catapult.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: That cover was in a lousy spot.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: How was I supposed to blast those slugs if I didn't have line-of-sight?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Besides, I wouldn't have gotten jumped if Spot wasn't holed up in the back.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Me? Holed up in the back?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Open your eyes, sister. That was simulated Originium artillery.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You and Midnight would've been dust if I didn't have my shield up there.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Not that things turned out much different, in the end.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: While the result was less than elegant, my magnificent swordplay brought low at least three foes before I fell.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I think there was plenty of entertainment to be had.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I'm sorry... I didn't see the one behind...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I just wanted to cut through that bad guy for Miss Orchid...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: It's not about how many enemies you took out.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: It's about teamwork.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: We are Reserve Op Team A6.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: We are a—
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: A motley crew of misfits.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: I heard that, Catapult.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Never mind. Let's call it a day. Dismissed.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Why the long face, Orchid?
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Why do you think?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Spot, Catapult, Midnight. All good people, but why can't they get along when you put them together?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Beats me. They're hardly the weirdest, by Rhodes Island standards. People generally like them.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: I know.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Maybe some people just don't mix well.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Weren't the reserve op teams supposed to be experimental anyway? You could always apply for a transfer to Logistics Department.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: (Mutters) But I only volunteered for the front lines because I got tired of sitting in an office pushing papers.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: What was that?
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: You're right. When I was named captain of A6, HR told me not to feel pressure about it.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Then why do you—
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Still...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Rhodes Island must have put me in charge so I can help them figure out what a team is.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Individuality is all well and good, but it must be established on the basis of mutual respect. It's not ability they're missing; it's respect for each other.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Right now, A6 isn't a team; it's just a pile of strangers tossed into the same room.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Wait a second, Orchid. There are so many bright minds on Rhodes Island; surely you don't have to be the one who has to worry about it?
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: It's normal for me to worry, isn't it?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I just feel like they should get to know each other, because we talk about stuff like teamwork. Not as operators, but simply knowing each other as people.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: If they can establish basic social relationships, sit down and talk to each other calmly...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You've always been soft-hearted.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Let me try again.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Are you sure? You might be disappointed again.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: I'm not sure I can drink this hot cocoa in peace, if I don't at least try.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: That's the last card, Catapult!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: No peeking at Spot's cards!
attributes.name: Orchid
Catapult
attributes.content: It's called tactical recon!

attributes.name: Catapult
attributes.content: You have the Joker in your hand, don't you, Spot?
I can tell, the way your face froze!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: That's my poker face, you idiot. Besides... I win.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Straight.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Hey! You must've cheated! How did you get so lucky?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: I guess fate isn't smiling on Catapult today either.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: A magnificent play by Spot, though.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Even I got fooled.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Spot's so good!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Just lucky.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Next round?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: No rush. I prepared some snacks.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Mm... you really do know how to make a cup of tea, Orchid. I don't think I've had a cup this good in months.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Thanks, Midnight. By the way, these magazines are for you. I think you'll find the styles you're looking for in them.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Oh, you're too kind.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Hey, these cookies aren't bad.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Better than the ones I buy, at any rate.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: I'll get more next time. You should eat more, Spot. I don't see you outside often lately.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Tea parties are kind of a bother, but I don't mind free food and drink.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: They're great! You're awesome, Orchid!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Glad to see you guys looking relaxed.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: We really should be able to get along with one another, shouldn't we?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: If we can enjoy afternoon tea together...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'm sure we can learn to trust each other on the battlefield.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I think... we can try to get to know each other better.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Not as operators, but as friends.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Maybe we can talk about our interests, for example?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Captain, I'll be frank with you.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: What is it?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I think you're a decent person. You bought us stuff, helped us write our reports, even put together a nice tea party.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: But there's a one thing that's been bugging me—why do we have to look like a team?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: We're a team only because Rhodes Island happened to put us together. Sometimes a bad fit is a bad fit.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: You know I'm usually on your side, Orchid.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: But I have to agree with Catapult, even if her words are a little blunt.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: There's no need to force things. We could be cordial colleagues, friends even. But there's no need for us to act the part of family.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: It's not necessary, for you and for us.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: All I can say is don't be too hard on yourself, captain.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Why did everyone go away, Miss Orchid?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Was Popukar a bad girl?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You're a good girl, Popukar.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: It's a bunch of grown men and women who are bad...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: We screwed up.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I like summer.
The summer outfits column was one of my favorite jobs when I was still a fashion editor.
I'm not an outdoorsy or social woman, but I loved the feeling of vitality that models wearing those outfits gave off.
It's proof that someone is living a life.
And it helps me want to live mine.
How did it come to this? Maybe I should put in a transfer request with HR tomorrow.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Still...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Oh, screw it.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'm hurting all over, and the a/c's useless. How am I supposed to get any sleep like this?
attributes.name: Orchid
Orchid
attributes.content: Painkillers, painkillers...

attributes.name: Orchid
attributes.content: Ugh, I'm out.
Guess I need to go to the clinic.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I hate summer.
I hate that heat that engulfs my body.
And I hate how I ache when a humid breeze blows past.
The pain is almost unbearable on those wet, humid nights.
I didn't have to pass by the deck on my way to the clinic.
But I came anyway.
I wasn't sure why. Maybe it was because my body knew it wasn't painkillers that I really wanted.
There's someone on the deck, holding a bottle in his hand.
He's not wearing his signature smile, only calmness with a hint of melancholy.
...Orchid?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: He tries to hide the bottle, but there is nowhere on the deck to hide it. He ends up abashedly stashing it behind his back.
I-I was just catching some fresh air—
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: ...Are you hurting?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Then stay put.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'm not here to scold you.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Pour me one.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Do you drink too?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I'm not proud of it, but I do.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I hate the feeling of being drunk.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Hah, I had customers like that.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: No fans of the nightlife scene, but they were forced to come by their bosses or friends.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: How did you deal with them?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Get them drunk so that they'd pay you?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: People who are actually drunk didn't pay all that much.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: The ones who actually loosened their purse strings were the types who kept themselves bottled up, until they decideed to pour out a little bit of their true selves to a stranger under the influence.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Are you saying I'm your favorite kind of customer?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: They were my friends. Best friends.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Honeyed words.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Spot can testify. I showed him some photos of me with my friends.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Am I right, Spot?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Spot?!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Just so it's clear, I was here first, then Midnight showed up second. Now you make three.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Does Oripathy give everyone a desire for fresh air at night?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Reading comics in a place like this... you'll ruin your eyes.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: My vision is excellent, thank you very much.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: But frankly, I like you more right now than I usually like you, Captain.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: That's a brand new compliment...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Do you get together here often?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Sometimes. Spot's not exactly my type.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Total coincidence, alright? Plenty of people show up here at night, but we happen to be the only ones today—
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Oh.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Miss Orchid! You're really here!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Catapult! Popukar! What are you two—
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I couldn't sleep because my eye was hurting. I was looking for you but I didn't know where you were.
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: So I asked Catapult, and she found you, just like that?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Catapult...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: (Whisper) Uh, it's not like that, Captain.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: (Whisper) I was gonna take her some place I was familiar with, give her some candy, and put her to bed.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: (Whisper) I had no idea all of you were here.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: (Whisper) Do people really come here so often? I was just making that up!
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: ...Now this is more like it.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: What's everyone doing here?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Does your eye still hurt, Popukar?
attributes.name: Orchid
Popukar
attributes.content: Yeah.

attributes.name: Popukar
attributes.content: But I feel better now that you're all here!
What about the rest of you?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Come now, this is not a debriefing.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I can tell you, I'm hurting like hell.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I doubt Popukar could have woken me up if I wasn't hurting.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: I wouldn't be reading comics if I wasn't hurting.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: I already told you.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Did anyone bring painkillers?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I brought some when I left my room. There should be enough for all of us.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: You got any more drinks up your sleeves, Midnight?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Spot was actually right when he said people like to get some fresh air on deck.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: That's why I've got various drinks stowed up here, just in case.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: 'Just in case.' Is that a synonym for 'everything'?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Everything.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Let's have a drink, then.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Here? Now?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: What? Did you think I was just going to dismiss you?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Or say something that would make me want to jump off this deck, like you did earlier today.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Too tired for that.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I think I like you better when you're tired.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Then you don't know me well enough. This is how I usually am.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I only do all that stuff because I'm your captain. Can you imagine how pissed I was when you didn't respond to it?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Well, I just didn't like it.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Alright, sorry.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Nothing. Just that I guess we really didn't know each other well enough.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: What would you like to drink, Popukar?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Apple juice! Mr. Midnight!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Here you go.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I want gin!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Sure.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Brandy! Mr. Midnight!
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You've got hands, use them.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Jerk.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: I once read in a magazine—
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: True friendship is not about knowing what your friends like. It's about knowing what they don't like.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I have a suggestion.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Why don't we talk about our disinterests?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I'll start. I hate anything that keeps people from smiling. Illness, war, hatred, lies, cheating...
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Wait a minute, the list's getting weird.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Because that's how things are. There are just so many things that can keep someone from smiling.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: That's true.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Thanks. What about you, Catapult?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Oh, there are plenty of things I hate. A boring life, bad food, tedious missions. Oh, and those knights carrying their swords and shields!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: How did you live for so long with so much hate in your heart?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Because I live to spite the things I hate!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Never mind me. I think you might hate even more things than I do, Spot.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: No way.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Unlike you, my hatred is directed towards very specific things. Cheerful people, arrogant people, smooth-talking people, people with too much energy...
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You might as well say that you hate everyone. Besides, you're obviously talking about us!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Let me finish.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You guys are a lot like the people that I hate, but I guess you're the exception that proves the rule.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Whoa, we've got a weirdo here.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: You're the last person I want to hear that from.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: So Spot hates everyone, except us. Does that sound better?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I think I'm already having second thoughts.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: What about you, Popukar?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I... I... I hate...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Getting sleepy? Come, you can rest on my lap.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: No... I wanna... hang out...
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Alright, alright.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I think that's enough for tonight.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You're not running away, are you, Captain?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Are you?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: It would be most dastardly.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I hate Oripathy. I hate not being able to sleep because of the pain.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I hate that I'm forced to accept all of this, when I never asked for it.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Is that why you wanted to deal with us in your own way, so that you could feel like everything's normal?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: I don't know. But I assure you that I've given up on being a good captain.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I won't put what happened tonight in my reports.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'll still give my orders in the next test, but I'll let you act as you see fit.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: That's good news.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: I think that's enough drinks for tonight. It's time to go to bed.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: One last toast before we go?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Sure, sounds fun.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: ...Alright.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: ...You guys weren't like this earlier today.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: It's a worthy night for a toast, isn't it?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: To what, though?
attributes.name: Catapult
Orchid
attributes.content: To all of us hurting like hell right now.
Oh, come on, really?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: But you know what? I like it.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Not bad.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: It hurts like hell. But it feels better when you know there are people hurting together with you.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You know, Orchid... all those friends of mine who keep themselves bottled up, until they decide to pour out a little bit of their true selves to a stranger under the influence... they all had one thing in common.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: They all thought their pain was unique, until they poured it out.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Did you really think I wouldn't get angry?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You wouldn't, because you know exactly what I'm talking about.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: ...It's hardly a positive thing to know that one's pain is not unique. And sharing one's pain is just that, nothing more. Bottling up isn't so bad.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Try something simpler the next time you're trying to comfort someone.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: We just happened to gather here tonight because of a common reason. It doesn't mean anything.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: But I wouldn't have had this drink, if not for this coincidence.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: You have good taste in wine.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Thank you.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Heavies, 12 o'clock! Get on it, Spot!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I was already on my way!
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Quit posing, Midnight! Are you trying to get me killed?
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Patience, patience, I'm looking for an elegant angle.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: You're blocking the light, Spot.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Midnight!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Enough talk! Cut inside from the left flank! Stop the two light units!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Aye-aye, Orchid-sama.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Catapult! There's a sniper behind the bunker!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Blow him to smithereens! Don't worry about the bunker!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Out of the way if you don't want to be well-done!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Catapult! You almost took out my hair with that grenade!
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Well, your hair's still there, isn't it? Quit complaining!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: That's more like it. Popukar! Help Spot push that big guy away!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Okay!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: I won't let you hurt Mr. Spot!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: (Together) Orchid!
attributes.name: Team A6

attributes.content: I know! Don't rush me!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Tactical flag—
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Got it!
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.text: \n\nCongratulations, Reserve Op Team A6. <color=#00ff00>You passed the test</color>.

attributes.content: I'm exhausted—!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: C-? Hard work really doesn't pay, does it?
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Look happier. At least you're alive.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: The score was not very elegant, but I did strike the perfect pose with my last move, didn't I?
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Everyone was so cool!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: You guys...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Heh, I thought Spot was gonna phone it in for sure.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: As for me, I always thought Orchid made a perfect captain. At least she helps me think up excuses for my reports.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Brown-noser. I thought YOU were going to phone it in.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Besides, I never said Orchid wasn't a good captain. She helped me look for a comic the other day.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: As for me, I've always felt that Orchid was my goddess of victory.
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Spot.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Yeah, on three. Three, two, one.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: Disgusting slug!
attributes.name: Catapult & Spot

attributes.content: Orchid!
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: You came too?
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I was worried about you.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: But it looks like A6 is in much better shape now. Did that method you were talking about work?
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Not even a little bit. It's a long story.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'll tell you about it next time. But today...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I know, I know. Go, your team is waiting.
attributes.name: Logistics Operator

attributes.content: Kill yourself, Midnight.
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Today is the day I rid Rhodes Island of this pest.
attributes.name: Spot

attributes.content: You can kill me, but you will never kill my pure heart!
attributes.name: Midnight

attributes.content: Miss Orchid! What do we do?
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Oh, come on...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Put away your chainsaw, Popukar.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Hm? Oh, okay!
attributes.name: Popukar

attributes.content: Alright, that's enough.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Yes, ma'am.
attributes.name: Catapult & Spot & Midnight

attributes.content: Let's go. We'll celebrate in the cafeteria.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Today...
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: ...is NOT on me. Everyone pays for their own.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: Miser!
attributes.name: Catapult

attributes.content: Shut up.
attributes.name: Orchid

attributes.content: I'm broke, I have to save up for fabric!
attributes.name: Orchid
